title: Sundial Goods / colour campaign
organizingIdea: A cropped-looking but fully readable type field meets a bold product illustration; colour choices become broad navigable fields and the interior exposes product facts before options.

facts.name: Sundial Goods
facts.restriction: No actual stock, certifications or purchasing system

provenance.content: Original fictional Vitris teaching brief and authored copy; operational details, dimensions and offers are invented and must never populate customer inventories.
provenance.media: Original inline SVG illustrations authored for this release; no external photographs, branding or type assets.
provenance.rights: Original Vitris teaching material; factual adaptation required for customer use.

storyboard.mobile: Campaign type precedes object; colour choices form two columns then explicit product detail options stack with their labels.

designDecisions: A cropped-looking but fully readable type field meets a bold product illustration; colour choices become broad navigable fields and the interior exposes product facts before options.
status: compiled and automated/assistant visually reviewed; human preference pending

visualReview.scope: desktop/mobile homepage/interior full-page contact-sheet review; batch comparison
visualReview.assessment: All four full-page views visually inspected in contact sheet. Bold campaign, object illustration and broad colour choice fields give different density from conventional product cards. Narrow campaign type precedes object and swatches; product detail reverses emphasis toward object then facts. Comparison labels remain readable. Teaching stock/prices are explicit, no checkout. Loop and Sundial share a wide two-column opening, justified by poster interpretation versus merchandise comparison; later sequences, navigation and actions differ. Further batch will add non-split openings.
